The time to export a standard 10-minute video is 12 minutes for the Kestrel 15 laptop and 5 minutes for the Atlas Go laptop. The time to charge to 80% is 75 minutes for the Kestrel 15 laptop and 30 minutes for the Atlas Go laptop. The number of ports is 1 port for the Kestrel 15 laptop and 4 ports for the Atlas Go laptop. The peak screen brightness is 350 nits for the Kestrel 15 laptop and 600 nits for the Atlas Go laptop.
